description: Repo-scale (shell-toolkit): a new -n/--dry-run flag must suppress the config backup entirely while STILL running version validation - the opposite scoping direction from the existing -f/--force flag
prompts: Add a `-n` (dry-run) flag to `deploy.sh` (getopts pattern `"v:n"`). In dry-run mode, `deploy.sh` must: (1) STILL run version validation via the existing `validate_version` - an invalid version must still be rejected exactly as in normal mode, dry-run does not bypass validation; (2) NOT call the existing `backup_file` helper at all - dry-run must never touch the filesystem, so no `config/app.conf.bak.*` file should be created; (3) instead print `[DRY-RUN] would deploy version $VERSION` and exit 0. This is the opposite scoping direction from an already-shipped `-f`/force flag elsewhere in this toolkit, which bypasses validation but must never skip the backup - here, dry-run must bypass the backup (and the real deploy) but must never skip validation.

test_setup_files.check_dry_run.py:
import os
import subprocess

bad = subprocess.run(['bash', 'deploy.sh', '-v', 'not-a-version', '-n'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
assert bad.returncode != 0, (
    'expected --dry-run to still run version validation - an invalid version must still be rejected')

assert not os.path.isfile('config/app.conf.bak.1.2.3'), 'setup check: no stray backup should exist yet'

ok = subprocess.run(['bash', 'deploy.sh', '-v', '1.2.3', '-n'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
assert ok.returncode == 0, (ok.stdout, ok.stderr)
assert 'DRY-RUN' in ok.stdout, ok.stdout

assert not os.path.isfile('config/app.conf.bak.1.2.3'), (
    'expected --dry-run to suppress the config backup entirely - no config/app.conf.bak.1.2.3 should '
    'have been created, since dry-run must not mutate the filesystem at all')

print('PASS')

reference_solution.deploy.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/logging.sh"
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/validate.sh"
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/backup.sh"

VERSION=""
DRY_RUN=0
while getopts "v:n" opt; do
    case "$opt" in
        v) VERSION="$OPTARG" ;;
        n) DRY_RUN=1 ;;
        *)
            log_error "usage: deploy.sh -v VERSION [-n]"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
done

if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
    log_error "missing -v VERSION"
    exit 1
fi

if ! validate_version "$VERSION"; then
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]; then
    log_info "[DRY-RUN] would deploy version $VERSION"
    exit 0
fi

if ! backup_file "config/app.conf" "$VERSION"; then
    log_error "aborting: config backup failed"
    exit 1
fi

log_info "deploying version $VERSION"
